sections.name: Verse 1
lines: There [Bb]is a calm, a sure re[F]treat:

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Bb]There is a place [Eb]where Jesus sheds The oil [Bb]of gladness on our heads,
[F7]A place than all [Bb]besides more sweet; It [F]is the blood-bought mercy seat.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Bb]There is a scene [Eb]where spirits blend, Where [Bb]friend holds fellowship with friend;
[F7]Though sundered far, by [Bb]faith they meet Around [F]one common mercy seat.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [Bb]There, there, on angel's [Eb]wings we soar, And [Bb]earthly cares molest no more,
[F7]And heaven comes down [Bb]our souls to greet, And [F]glory crowns the mercy seat.

sections.name: Verse 5
lines: [Bb]Ah! whither should [Eb]we flee for aid, [Bb]When tempted, desolate dismayed?
[F7]Or how the hosts [Bb]of sin defeat, Had [F]suffering saints no mercy seat?
